how: Frozen artefact, no refit. Same test plants, fixtures, calibration offsets and rounding as eval.json; only the subset differs. Truth = Climate TRACE v5.10.0 modelled SEE and the prior is the plant's own Climate TRACE history, so these numbers measure persistence/consistency with Climate TRACE, not real-world accuracy (see MODEL_CARD.md section 0).

turkiye.definition: iso3 == TUR among the held-out TEST plants of the round-2 split (seed 20261019)

with_prior.caveat: not statistically powered: n = 4 plants (230 plant-months, strongly correlated within plant); treat every number as an anecdote about these plants, not an estimate for Turkiye

detection_synthetic.note: red_rate at factor < 1 is recall on SYNTHETIC underreports (factor x Climate TRACE value); at 1x it is the false-red rate
